Aerodynamic_Contour_Feathers.description: These slender, iridescent feathers are a marvel of avian evolution, seamlessly integrating aerodynamic efficiency with graceful aesthetics, allowing the creature to cut through the air with unmatched speed and agility, while the intricate webbing between the feathers enhances evasion and aerial acrobatics.

Waterproof_Uropygial_Oil_Coating.description: This avian entity is covered in a thick, glistening layer of waterproof uropygial oil, which not only enhances its swimming and flying efficiency but also grants it a slippery defense that boosts its constitution and evasion, making it difficult to capture or harm.

Thermal_Down_Insulation.description: This avian-inspired thermal down insulation component, a rare and exquisite integument, is intricately woven with the feathers of legendary frost-resistant birds, providing an unparalleled warmth and comfort that boosts the wearer's constitution, allowing them to endure the harshest of climates without faltering.

Silent_Fringed_Owl_Plumage.description: The Silent_Fringed_Owl_Plumage, a rare and mystical avian integument, grants its bearer unparalleled stealth in the shadows, with feathers so finely textured they muffle even the softest sound, though at the cost of slight agility. This magical component bestows the innate abilities to ambush prey undetected and to blend into the night like a shadow among the trees.

Iridescent_Structural_Gorget.description: The Iridescent Structural Gorget is a delicate, yet robust, piece of armor that mimics the shimmering plumage of a hummingbird, its vibrant colors shifting in the light to captivate or startle observers, enhancing the wearer's charm while making stealthier movements more conspicuous.

Naked_Carrion_Vulture_Head.description: This entity component manifests as a grotesque, avian head with slick, nearly hairless skin that pulsates with an eerie, sickly sheen, perfectly adapted to resist the toxins of its carrion diet while its unsettling appearance and sharp senses make it a formidable, if unpleasant, presence in the darkest corners of the game world.

Cassowary_Wire_Bristles.description: The Cassowary_Wire_Bristles component adorns the avian warrior with a dense layer of rigid, wire-like bristles that serve as an additional natural armor, enhancing its defensive capabilities while slightly hindering its nimbleness, granting it the ability to forcefully block incoming attacks.

Cryptic_Bark_Mimicry_Plumage.description: Feathered in a cryptic bark pattern that blends seamlessly with the gnarled trunks of ancient forests, this avian integument grants its bearer unparalleled stealth, allowing them to mimic the stillness of a potoo bird and vanish into the shadows.

Powder_Down_Waterproofing.description: This avian integument, reminiscent of a heron's plumage, is covered in a fine layer of powdery down that not only enhances the creature's natural camouflage but also provides exceptional waterproofing, allowing it to move gracefully through both land and water with increased agility and awareness.

Toxic_Pitohui_Alkaloid_Feathers.description: The Toxic Pitohui Alkaloid Feathers are a rare avian integument imbued with potent toxins, causing the wearer's plumage to emit a faint, sickly glow and a noxious aura that repels foes while simultaneously poisoning any who dare to touch or be near them, though the wearer's charisma is slightly diminished due to the unnatural appearance.
